articles.title: How currency volatility is straining Indian trade
articles.summary: The Indian Rupee recently reached an all-time low of 90.96 per US dollar in December 2025, reigniting discussions about whether currency depreciation inherently boosts exports and corrects trade imbalances. For an SSB aspirant, comprehending such economic developments is vital as currency stability directly impacts national economic health, international trade competitiveness, and influences strategic national policy and resource management.

articles.title: India inks deals worth Rs 4,666 crore for close-quarter battle carbines & heavyweight torpedoes
articles.summary: India has inked significant defence deals worth Rs 4,666 crore to boost its military capabilities. The procurements include close-quarter battle carbines, crucial for ground forces in specific combat scenarios, and heavyweight torpedoes, which will enhance the Indian Navy's anti-submarine warfare prowess. These acquisitions underscore India's ongoing commitment to modernising its armed forces and strengthening national security.

articles.title: Op Sindoor, upgraded firepower and new battlefield structures: How Indian Army enhanced its warfighting edge in 2025
articles.summary: The Indian Army recently outlined ten major milestones for 2025, demonstrating its forward-looking strategy. Key areas covered include the After Action Review for Operation Sindoor, the induction of new capabilities and cutting-edge technology, and advancements in military diploma programs. This highlights the Army's commitment to enhancing operational effectiveness, technological prowess, and human resource development.

articles.title: Mobile app developer Techugo to raise climate-resilient agri services, intelligence service data on farmer platforms
articles.summary: Mobile app development firm Techugo plans to significantly enhance its climate-resilient agriculture services. This initiative focuses on improving traceability solutions, data intelligence, and farmer engagement platforms. By leveraging technology, Techugo aims to bolster sustainable agricultural practices and efficiency, addressing climate change challenges and benefiting the farming community through advanced digital solutions.

articles.title: Defence Ministry signs Rs 4,666 crore deals to buy new carbines and torpedoes
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence (MoD) signed contracts worth Rs 4,666 crore for procuring Close Quarter Battle (CQB) Carbines and Heavy Weight Torpedoes. This significant acquisition aims to bolster the capabilities of the Indian Armed Forces, enhancing their operational readiness. Such procurements are crucial for national security and military preparedness, directly impacting India's defence modernization efforts.

articles.title: Russia says its negotiating stance on Ukraine will toughen after accusing Kyiv of attack
articles.summary: The Kremlin has declared it will adopt a tougher stance in peace negotiations concerning the war in Ukraine. This decision comes after Russia accused Kyiv of a drone attack on a Russian presidential residence, an allegation Kyiv vehemently denies as baseless. Such developments indicate escalating tensions and could further complicate diplomatic efforts to resolve the ongoing international conflict.

articles.title: IOC train derailment pauses service in Labrador West for at least week
articles.summary: A train derailment over the weekend has caused significant disruptions to services in Labrador West, expected to last at least a week. The Iron Ore Company of Canada confirmed the incident in a social media post on Monday evening. This event underscores the impact of infrastructure failures on regional logistics and operations, affecting local communities and supply chains.

articles.title: PLA conducts major drill near Taiwan
articles.summary: The People's Liberation Army (PLA) recently executed a large-scale, interservice military exercise, conducted around a Chinese island. These drills underscore the PLA's focus on integrated operational capabilities and enhancing combat readiness across its branches. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing regional defence developments, geopolitical significance, and the evolving nature of military power projection in the region.
